messages:
noah: Heads-up from finance: small but steady billing delta since midnight. Some dedicated SA requests are being charged to org-level rather than project. Anyone tracking this?

sophia: yep, saw ~0.7% tokens to org:unknown in the quota panel for dedicated pools.

raj: quick trace shows service tokens minted via the new cross-project mint API lack `project_id` claim when they hit auth-router. Router falls back to org attribution. snippet: 
```
WARN auth-router: token=sub=service:acct-xyz claims_missing=[project_id] action=attribute_to_org org=org:12345
```

dena: Dedicated sidecars still on exchange v2.0.3 which returns a claim blob; hosted uses v2.1.0 which attaches project. mismatch explains it.

noah: options: 1) auth-router calls `GET /claim` for missing project (sync), 2) force urgent sidecar update, 3) upstream add `x-quota-owner`.

raj: propose 1 behind flag: conditional GET /claim only for service tokens missing project_id, cache results for 60s, emit `auth.missing_project_resolves`. Lower deploy surface and quick fix.

sophia: product wants accuracy over tiny latency; ops wants limited RT. Add 150ms timeout + circuit-breaker. Also create dashboard tiles: misattributed_quota_rate, claim_resolve_latency, sidecar_version_breakdown.

dena: agreed. Also export audit logs of resolved claims for finance reconciliation. Auth-router must not block requests if exchange fails.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Feature-flag `auth.resolve_missing_project` enabled for group `dedicated-alpha` at 2025-11-04T02:12:05Z.

noah: timeline: raj opens small PR with flag, cache, metrics, header `x-quota-owner` when resolved. canary for alpha, monitor 6h, then expand. Sophia to add dashboard + export.

sophia: will add panels and an alert: page if misattributed_quota_rate > 0.5% for 10m, and add audit export to GCS.

raj: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-router/pull/395 (conditional claim resolve).

noah: thanks team — we'll monitor and sync with finance tomorrow AM.
